verdict.status: investigating - REOPENED 2026-11-06 from the 2026-10-22 park: the access/history blocker ('no anonymous historical bulk source exists') is contradicted by new evidence - an anonymous plain-HTTP history channel serves the daily 07:00 records for all 21 major reservoirs back to ~2008-2010 (full fields) with per-day queries

contracts.redistribution: SUPPORTED, class B, with one channel nuance to confirm at ready-review: the underlying water-situation series carries Open Government Data License 1.0 on data.gov.tw (45501 quote recorded 2026-10-22, '授權方式: 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版; 計費方式: 免費'), and dataset 45501's own note routes history queries to the fhyv2 viewer - but the fhyv2/Disaster channel pages themselves state only a copyright footer ('經濟部水利署©2015 版權所有'), not the ODDL text.
contracts.prediction_timing: SUPPORTED for a clearly-labelled RETROSPECTIVE task; operational historical availability stays an assumption: records are the daily 07:00 observations, entered by reservoir managers by 09:30 per dataset 41568's own statement; same-day visibility of the 07:00 record measured once (2026-11-06 record readable at ~08:45 Taipei). Whether past years' records were published same-day when they occurred is not evidenced by this current system (cpcb-aqi-exceedance current-vintage precedent); the vintage assumption must be declared in the evaluation contract, and forward lag pinning would need a daily capture of the history API (POST; the standing-capture mechanism currently supports GET only).
contracts.target: SUPPORTED: binary drought onset - CapacityRate (蓄水百分比) crossing below threshold within (t, t+30] while above it at t; label source column excludable from features by the trailing-window construction. Censoring recorded: stations 20202/20501/20503 measured below 25% even in wet periods (2025-06-15, 2026-11-06), so a level-class label would carry chronic positives - the onset formulation plus per-station eligibility (rate >= threshold at the instant) is required, and chronic-low stations may need exclusion.
contracts.split_capacity: PARTIAL - the one unresolved contract: history depth measured by sampling (2003/2005 all-null CapacityRate; 2008-01-01 6/21 stations populated; 18-19/21 populated by 2015; single-station 2010/2015 rates present), and label presence measured by dated anchors in three known episodes (2015 northern: 8 stations <0.30 on 2015-03-15, min 0.1607; 2021 island-wide: 12 stations <0.25 on 2021-04-15, min 0.0175; 2024 southern: 7 stations <0.30 on 2024-04-15, min 0.0569), but exact per-window onset counts and per-station panel-start years require the full panel - a bounded worker extraction (construction-side; samples are not counts).
contracts.not_a_mirror: SUPPORTED at search level (web search 2026-11-06): no packaged, split, scored benchmark for reservoir storage drought-onset or storage prediction found. Comparators are literature studies on other/formulation-different tasks (Korean dam storage 6-month deep-learning forecasting, EES 2026, data from KMA/WAMIS portals; Shihmen/Mingde monthly effective-capacity forecasting, ESPR 2026, data from the WRA open database + CWA CODIS; Shihmen typhoon inflow event forecasting, NHESS 2026, data on request) and raw-data mirrors without task packaging (ResOpsUS v2 US reservoir storage time series; USGS CONUS anomalously-low-storage metrics 1981-2020). Ours contributes: station-day binary onset task on Taiwan's 21 major reservoirs from the publisher's own daily instrument, ~2008-2026, temporal splits with episode-clustered counts, threshold bound to a publisher-relevant fixture. The formal check-novelty.py verdict is recorded at ready-review.

verdict.uncertainty: The per-window split counts and per-station panel-start years are the decisive uncertainty between investigating and ready - they need the full-panel fetch (1 request/day, all 21 stations, ~6,900-8,800 requests for 2003-2026, measured 1.1-1.7 s/request with fresh-TLS urllib from the coordinator, ~9.5 KB/request). Secondary: threshold binding (0.25 candidate; bind to the WRA's own drought-response stages or a measured known-event fixture) and the ODDL-covers-this-channel confirmation.
verdict.next: Worker-side panel-count pass (discovery-owned measurement, construction boundary - no labelled panel on the coordinator), then five-contract re-reconciliation and check-novelty.py to a ready verdict.

prediction_question: Will a major Taiwan reservoir's effective storage ratio fall below a drought threshold (e.g. 20-30%) within the next 30 days, conditioned on it being above the threshold now (onset formulation)?
prediction_time: Daily at 09:30 Taipei (UTC+8), after the day's 07:00 observation is entered (dataset 41568's own statement: managers enter the daily operation table by 09:30; measured once: the 2026-11-06 07:00 records were readable from the history API at ~08:45 Taipei the same day). Features are daily 07:00 records up to and including the instant day; the target window is the following 30 daily records, none of which precedes the instant.
target_definition: Binary onset: storage percentage (蓄水百分比) of reservoir R crosses below the threshold on some daily record within (t, t+30] while above it at t. Label source column is the same series' future values; excluded from features by the window construction.

A full daily panel needs one request per day.

measurements.fhy_construction_cost_2026_11_06: Measured per-request cost (coordinator, fresh TLS each request): 1.1-1.7 s, ~9.5 KB for all 21 stations one day. Full daily panel 2003-2026 = one request per day, ~8,800 requests (or ~6,900 from 2008), ~65-85 MB total, est. 2.5-4.5 h serial at measured latency; keep-alive connection reuse and bounded concurrency to be measured on the worker. No rate limit hit at 8-request burst; WAF rejects some GET query shapes ('Request Rejected' page for /OpenApiv3 $filter=Time ge 2015-01-01 with spaces) but all form POSTs answered 200.
measurements.waf_and_session_notes_2026_11_06: The /disaster/Reservoir/Comparison page HTML itself needs the fhyv2 session context (Referer) to serve full HTML; the POST history API does not need any session state. Browser harness quirk recorded: Runtime.evaluate waits max 5 s for the daemon - long multi-fetch JS loops must be split across calls or they time out without aborting navigation state.

next_action: REOPENED 2026-11-06 (parked 2026-10-22 on access/history; that blocker is now contradicted by measurement). The one remaining gate to ready is the split-capacity count, which needs the full panel and therefore belongs on a worker (construction-side; no labelled panel on the coordinator). Next, in order: (1) worker panel-count pass (discovery-owned measurement): fetch day-by-day via GetComparision for all 21 stations (1 request/day, ~6,900-8,800 requests for 2003-2026, ~9.5 KB each; measured 1.1-1.7 s/request fresh-TLS from the coordinator; use a keep-alive session, polite rate, and record request count/bytes/wall-clock per the cost-evidence rule) and compute WITHOUT any model: per-station panel-start years, per-window onset counts for candidate temporal windows (e.g. train 2008-2019 / eval 2020-2022 / holdout 2023-2026) at the candidate 0.25 and 0.30 thresholds, episode-clustered positives (2015 northern, 2021 island-wide, 2024 southern measured at anchor days), and chronic-low station inventory (20202/20501/20503 measured below 0.25 in wet periods; 30802 in one). (2) Bind the threshold to a publisher-relevant instrument or fixture (WRA drought-response stages / 減壓供水 announcements, or the measured 2021-04-15 anchor where 12 stations sat below 0.25 during the documented island-wide drought). (3) Re-reconcile the five contracts (redistribution: confirm the ODDL grant reading for this channel, or record operator risk acceptance; timing: retrospective scope with the current-vintage assumption declared, cpcb-aqi-exceedance precedent; optionally seed a daily POST capture for forward lag pinning - the standing-capture mechanism is GET-only, a small extension). (4) check-novelty.py verdict (prior-art search already run 2026-11-06, recorded in verdict.contracts.not_a_mirror). Then ready-review.
review: Reopened 2026-11-06. The 2026-10-22 park was correct on the evidence it had (the /Api/v2 401s and the truncated AngularJS shell); the miss was that the legacy /Disaster/api/ family - the one the SPA's comparison tab actually uses for history - is anonymous plain-HTTP POST and was invisible until the SPA bundle chain was read in the browser. Five contracts now: redistribution SUPPORTED (class B, channel-page nuance recorded), timing SUPPORTED for a labelled retrospective task (07:00 observation, 09:30 entry statement, one same-day visibility measurement; historical vintage assumption to declare), target SUPPORTED (onset formulation; chronic-low censoring recorded), split capacity PARTIAL (depth and episode presence measured by sampling; exact counts need the worker panel pass), not-a-mirror SUPPORTED at search level. The candidate is NOT ready: split counts are an essential measurement that must not be replaced by samples.
